name: Institutional Control Environment Risk
description: Indicators that the institution's own control environment may be weakened, increasing residual exposure to financial crime. Covers governance, alert backlogs, tuning gaps, insider risk, data quality and outsourcing. Intended for the control-effectiveness side of an enterprise-wide risk assessment.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach (sector-specific guidance series, general principles)
FATF Recommendations, Recommendation 1 and Interpretive Note (assessing risks and applying a risk-based approach)
Wolfsberg Group, Guidance on a Risk Based Approach for Managing Money Laundering Risks (2006)

indicators.name: Weak AML governance and oversight
indicators.desc: Board and senior management receive limited or irregular financial crime reporting and there is unclear accountability.
indicators.ctx: Board and senior management receive limited or irregular financial crime reporting and there is unclear accountability.
indicators.fp: Small firms may have lean but effective governance.

indicators.name: Persistent alert backlog
indicators.desc: Monitoring or screening alerts stay unreviewed beyond service levels.
indicators.ctx: Monitoring or screening alerts stay unreviewed beyond service levels.

indicators.name: Monitoring scenarios not tuned or validated
indicators.canon: Monitoring scenarios not tuned or validated
indicators.desc: Rules and models have not been calibrated, tested or reviewed against current risk.
indicators.ctx: Rules and models have not been calibrated, tested or reviewed against current risk.
indicators.fp: Stable portfolios may need little change.

indicators.name: Staff collusion or insider risk indicators
indicators.canon: Staff override of controls or excessive record access
indicators.desc: Employees override approvals, alter records, access records without need or show unusual relationships with customers.
indicators.ctx: Employees show unusual relationships with customers, override controls or access records without need.

indicators.name: Poor customer and transaction data quality
indicators.canon: Poor customer and transaction data quality
indicators.desc: Missing, inconsistent or incorrectly mapped data weakens screening and monitoring.
indicators.ctx: Missing, inconsistent or incorrectly mapped data weakens screening and monitoring.

indicators.name: Significant outsourcing of control activities
indicators.desc: Screening, onboarding or investigation tasks are outsourced with limited oversight.
indicators.ctx: Screening, onboarding or investigation tasks are outsourced with limited oversight.

indicators.name: Overdue periodic reviews or KYC refresh
indicators.canon: Overdue periodic reviews or KYC refresh
indicators.desc: Customer reviews exceed scheduled dates, particularly for high-risk customers.
indicators.ctx: Customer reviews exceed scheduled dates, particularly for high-risk customers.

indicators.name: Inadequate or outdated enterprise risk assessment
indicators.canon: Inadequate or outdated enterprise risk assessment
indicators.desc: Risk assessment is stale, unscoped, or not used to drive controls.
indicators.ctx: Risk assessment is stale, unscoped, or not used to drive controls.

indicators.name: Insufficient training or low staff awareness
indicators.canon: Insufficient training or low staff awareness
indicators.desc: Staff cannot recognise red flags, late completion of training, high error rates in quality checks.
indicators.ctx: Staff cannot recognise red flags, late completion of training, high error rates in quality checks.

indicators.name: Slow or poor-quality suspicious activity reporting
indicators.canon: Slow or poor-quality suspicious activity reporting
indicators.desc: Reports are filed late, are thin in content or the volume is out of line with peers.
indicators.ctx: Reports are filed late, are thin in content or the volume is out of line with peers.

indicators.name: Unresolved audit or regulatory findings
indicators.desc: Previous findings remain open or recur.
indicators.ctx: Previous findings remain open or recur.
indicators.fp: Remediation can be long-running by design.
